label: Revenue from operations
definition: Total revenue from operations as reported (sale of products and services plus other operating revenue, net of GST).

label: Other income
definition: Non-operating income such as interest, dividends and gains on investments.

label: Cost of materials consumed
definition: Raw and packing materials used in production.

label: Purchases of stock-in-trade
definition: Finished goods bought for resale.

label: Changes in inventories of finished goods, work-in-progress and stock-in-trade
definition: Movement in finished and semi-finished stock during the year.
sign_convention: As reported: positive = inventory fell (adds to cost); negative = inventory rose

label: Employee benefits expense
definition: Salaries, wages, bonus, contributions to funds and staff welfare.

label: Finance costs
definition: Interest and other borrowing costs (includes interest on lease liabilities).

label: Depreciation and amortisation expense
definition: Depreciation of fixed and right-of-use assets and amortisation of intangibles.

label: Other expenses
definition: All remaining operating expenses (freight, advertising, power, etc.).

label: Share of profit/(loss) of associates and joint ventures
definition: Group's share of profit of entities it does not fully control.

label: Exceptional items
definition: One-off items reported separately (e.g. gain on sale of land, impairment).
sign_convention: Positive = gain; negative = loss (effect on profit)

label: Profit before tax
definition: Profit after exceptional items and share of associates/JVs and before tax.

label: Total tax expense
definition: Current tax plus deferred tax (and prior-year tax adjustments).

label: Profit for the year
definition: Profit after tax for the whole group.

label: Profit attributable to owners of the parent
definition: Profit for the year less the share belonging to non-controlling interests.

label: Total equity
definition: Equity attributable to owners plus non-controlling interests.

label: Equity attributable to owners of the parent
definition: Share capital plus other equity belonging to the parent's shareholders.

label: Non-current borrowings
definition: Long-term borrowings, excluding lease liabilities.

label: Current borrowings
definition: Short-term borrowings including current maturities of long-term debt, excluding lease liabilities.

label: Cash and cash equivalents
definition: Cash and deposits with original maturity of three months or less.

label: Bank balances other than cash and cash equivalents
definition: Fixed deposits with longer maturities and earmarked balances.

label: Current investments
definition: Liquid investments, mainly mutual funds, held as part of treasury.

label: Inventories
definition: Raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, stock-in-trade and stores.

label: Trade receivables (current)
definition: Amounts owed by customers and dealers due within one year.

label: Trade payables (current)
definition: Amounts owed to suppliers (MSME and others combined).

label: Total assets
definition: Sum of non-current and current assets.

label: Total equity and liabilities
definition: Total equity plus all liabilities; must equal total assets.

label: Net cash from operating activities
definition: Cash generated by operations after tax paid.

label: Purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets
definition: Cash spent on fixed assets (including capital work-in-progress and capital advances where reported together).
sign_convention: Stored as a positive number (cash outflow)
